d:
Jharkhand men kanun-vyavastha (Law and Order) ke mudde par siyasat tej ho gaee hai. rajy men lo end ordar ki sthiti ko lekar JMM aur BJP aamne-samne aa gaee hain. donon dalon ke netaon ke bich jubani jang dekhne ko mili. ek-dusre par aarop-pratyarop lagate hue netaon ne kanun-vyavastha ko lekar apni-apni bat rakhi.
